## Results

- Solves soldier-to-billet assignment exactly with the Hungarian algorithm (scipy linear_sum_assignment) over a multi-factor cost matrix
- Geographic cost model covering 56 installations across 6 combatant command AORs

## The problem

Brigade staffs sourcing billets for exercises and deployments must balance qualifications, readiness gates, unit cohesion, and travel cost across many soldiers and installations, usually by hand.

## What I built

Synthetic soldier, billet, and MTOE generators; a pairwise cost matrix combining TDY dollars (haversine distance across 56 installations with a tiered cost model), MOS/rank/skill/clearance/airborne/language/availability/dwell penalties, priority weights, and readiness, cohesion, and geographic layers; solved exactly with scipy linear_sum_assignment (Hungarian); a heuristic agent tunes penalty weights toward a target fill; a Pareto explorer maps cost-cohesion-fill trade-offs.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## What it is for

Supports a force-sourcing decision (who fills which billet for an exercise such as Valiant Shield) and shows how policy weights shift the trade-off between travel cost and readiness. This is a core ORSA manning and assignment problem.
:::

## Tools

Python, SciPy (linear_sum_assignment), pandas, NumPy, Streamlit, Plotly, Folium
